create_eval_runner: create an EvalRunner with a dataloader, EvalUnit, callbacks, and max steps per epoch
run_eval_runner: run the EvalRunner to evaluate a model using TorchTNT's evaluate function
save_eval_state: save the EvalRunner state to a checkpoint location during preemptions
load_eval_state: load the EvalRunner state from a checkpoint location for resuming evaluation
review_eval_runner_class: review the EvalRunner class and its integration with TorchTNT evaluate framework
